models.why: DFlash2 speculative decoding pushes Qwen3.8-27B to about 70 tok/s on an M5 Max MacBook Pro - the drafter, not the decode loop, is what makes a 27B model usable on a laptop.

models.name: ThinkingCap 27B
models.full_name: ThinkingCap 27B (BottleCap AI fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B, EXL3 4.0 bpw)
models.why: ThinkingCap - BottleCap AI's fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B - cut GPQA thinking-token use by 62% versus base Qwen3.8-27B while holding accuracy, and decodes 54 tok/s on code on a single DGX Spark with the TensorFold recipe (45.7 tok/s under TandemLLM).
